statement: A_J_eff owns only the U_B^2 bulk source and m_L terms; it does not absorb static boundary hair.
In the private compact no-flux/no-incoming selector, B_boundary,a may be set to zero only if the same collar theorem covers the arena projection.
For open, radiative, rotating or off-centre systems, B_boundary,a must be carried as a separate finite product row.
The same A_src/A_lap/worldtube profile must feed PPN, R10, clocks and orbital tests; no per-arena retuning of A_J_eff.
formula: A_J_eff is shared; only K_a and B_boundary,a are arena-specific projections
